Container.Name: rpm-collection-daemon
Container.Overview: Keeps rpm music libraries on this server. rpm on your computer finds the server and offers it as a place for your collection. Your TVs and the people you share with play it from here.

Config.Name: Libraries
Config.Description: The folder that holds the rpm libraries. Share it over SMB.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where the daemon keeps its keys and the uploaded catalogues.

Config.Name: SMB address
Config.Description: How computers reach the libraries folder over SMB.

Config.Name: Space limit
Config.Description: For example 2TB. Empty for no limit.

Config.Name: Name
Config.Description: The name rpm shows. Empty for the server's name.
